2026.07.28.description:
### FIXED
- The Conquest map now updates instantly when a Chapter unlocks. No more backing out to the main menu and back in to see it reflected.
- Fixed the "next Chapter unlocked" reveal animation sometimes showing a Chapter as playable even though it wasn't actually unlocked yet.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.07.27...2026.07.28
2026.07.28.title: 2026.07.28 - Auto-Map Update

2026.07.28.2.description:
### FIXED
- Added an `archipelago.json` manifest to the released `.apworld`. Archipelago core requires this starting in 0.7.0.
- Added `tools/build_apworld.py` to package `worlds/northgard/` into `northgard.apworld`, stamping in each release's version automatically instead of building the zip by hand.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ChakraaThePanda/Archipelago-Northgard/compare/2026.07.28...2026.07.28.2
